rules.accepted_credit_types: All hours may be online through RACE-approved CE, of which 5 h must be live (interactive webinar or live-streamed); other approved programs
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prior-year graduates are exempt for that renewal cycle.
rules.notes: Certified veterinary technician/technologist credentials expire September 1 each year; CE earned Aug 1 - Aug 1. Copies of certificates sent at renewal. Renewal form also needs the employing DVM's signature.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 1701, R. 2.11; Miss. Code Ann. §73-39-63
rules.rule_quote: All certified veterinary technicians/technologists must earn a minimum of ten (10) continuing education credits with one clock hour earning one continuing credit which must be documented by submitting copies of registration and proof of attendance with the application for certification renewal.
